name: render-partial-merge-effect
reason: Pretty output retains a witnessed merge even if a later PR read errors.

name: show-merge-destination-in-status
reason: The human-visible table must show the actual destination as well as the merge state.

name: show-merge-destination-in-completion
reason: Completion of observation need not mean every PR landed on trunk.

name: show-single-merged-pr-in-ready-verdict
reason: A single already-merged PR is not just merge-ready.

name: show-observed-queue-state
reason: Pretty output must distinguish enrollment, a request and absence of enrollment too.

name: show-landing-in-status-table
reason: Do not infer forge enrollment from the Merge column’s green check.

name: label-local-queue-as-input
reason: Capturing a list of PRs is not enqueueing them.

name: show-landing-while-waiting
reason: Pretty wait reports observed GitHub state, not presumed queue enrollment.
anchor: is blocker-free; waiting for merge queue (${verdict.reason.unmergedCount}
replace: is open; ${verdict.reason.landing ? describeLanding(verdict.reason.landing) : "queue status not observed"} (${verdict.reason.unmergedCount}
